evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: This story specifies content identification/fingerprinting as the search method, which is a distinct requirement compared to other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Search by user profile is a different actor/context/goal than other discovery methods in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative/similar-user based discovery is meaningfully different from other search approaches.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: This focuses on content-similarity to a given music video (and ringback tones), a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Using enriched metadata/image tags as the discovery mechanism differs from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This is an upload-and-tagging requirement about tag persistence, not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnail sequences is a distinct UI/display requirement not repeated in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Generic 'similar items' info is differentiated from other stories by wording and scope (not perceptual-specific).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Specifies perceptual similarity as the basis, a meaningful distinction from generic similarity requests.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Content recommendation from similar profiles is a distinct recommendation trigger not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: News-event/location-based recommendations are a unique business rule compared to other recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification and related info is a specific recognition requirement distinct from product/logo/brand detection.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a different detection target than persons, logos, or brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection (broadcaster logos) is a specialized requirement distinct from other recognition stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from logos, products, or person detection by target and business goal.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-based query-to-video recommendation is a unique interaction not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geographical/map-based discovery is a distinct context and trigger for content access.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a specific technical approach different from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin actions for viewing/validating/editing segmentation are distinct from automatic segmentation tasks elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction for news segments is a unique admin requirement.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct administrative goal not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Detection of edited audio is a specific validation check distinct from general quality filtering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering nudity is a specific content-moderation requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset-based prefiltering (e.g., pixels/low-level features) is meaningfully different from high-level prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Automatic copyright validation is a unique compliance requirement not expressed elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag-based prefiltering differs from low-level prefiltering and is a separate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Assessment of image appeal/complexity using mixed inputs is a specific admin metric not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists based on annotations/Talk is a distinct trigger/action requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer type identification is a unique classification requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification for Galaxy Zoo is distinct from other project-specific tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Detection of images with no classifiable animals is a distinct requirement for Snapshot Serengeti.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Image-series detection for timestamp malfunction is a specific processing need different from classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is a different requirement than detecting empty or corrupt images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., attributes beyond species) is distinct from species or count tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a separate capability from species/attribute detection or empty-image detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization in Plankton Portal is a project-specific image analysis requirement distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Detecting empty/plankton-free images is distinct from segmentation or species classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a specific analytic requirement different from segmentation or species detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification in Plankton Portal is distinct from other plankton tasks listed.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis to reduce duration is a unique processing goal for Worm Watch Lab.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a distinct analytic requirement from motion/duration analysis.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite imagery is a distinct capability not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by volunteer experience is a specific calculation/metric distinct from identifying volunteer types.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is a specific preprocessing requirement not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct analytic requirement compared to other image tasks.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a distinct processing capability separate from A/V quality filtering or audio analysis tasks.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar whale calls is a species/audio-domain specific requirement distinct from other grouping stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting individual whales in audio is a distinct analytic need separate from grouping or detection tasks.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining interruption timing is a specific interaction-management requirement not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing interruption medium is a separate decision from just knowing when to interrupt.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining when to educate is a distinct trigger/goal from interruption or other actions.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education medium is a separate requirement from the timing of education.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Choosing the specific educational content is a distinct business rule from timing or medium selection.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is a unique monitoring requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Timing for Zoonibot comments is a specific automation trigger distinct from other Zoonibot behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Knowing when to provide an explanation is different from general commenting timing or content generation.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Content generation for Zoonibot is a distinct requirement separate from timing/triggers.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: General subject grouping is a separate, broad capability and not the same as any project-specific grouping story.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation based on volunteer history is a distinct personalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarizing articles for reuse is a distinct content-reuse/admin requirement not duplicated elsewhere.
